L0519

A policy-free unit unwrap/scale/rewrap can use direct scalar unit arithmetic

What

A policy-free unit unwrap/scale/rewrap can use direct scalar unit arithmetic

Why

The expression unwraps a linear unit, applies one scalar operation, and immediately rewraps the same unit

Fix

Use `unit * scalar`, `scalar * unit`, or `unit / scalar` directly

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L0519: tests/ui_lint/unit_scalar_rewrap.warn.

Warning [L0519] (unit_scalar_rewrap): A policy-free unit unwrap/scale/rewrap can use direct scalar unit arithmetic
  --> tests/ui_lint/unit_scalar_rewrap.jet:17:17
    |
 17 |     print(Meter.from_float(value.raw() * 2).raw())
    |                 ^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The expression unwraps a linear unit, applies one scalar operation, and immediately rewraps the same unit
 Fix: Use `unit * scalar`, `scalar * unit`, or `unit / scalar` directly
